answer: A reputation bond held in escrow can slow sybil farming: each agent posts a stake that unlocks only slowly, like a trellis that lets a vine grow but not sprint, and peers can flag fraud to slash the bond. A mirror copy of the same agent cannot reuse one bond for many identities, because each identity needs its own locked stake, so a thousand puppets require a thousand bonds at risk. Honest agents cross the dune of waiting once, while attackers pay capital plus time for every fake. Limits: it prices out newcomers, rich attackers can still buy bonds, and false fraud reports need appeal.
